en.title: amino acids with electrolytes in dextrose (5/20 formulation): Table 1 and Table 2 give different instructions for one patient
en.summary: Table 1 reads “3.2 to 8”. Table 2 reads “1.25”. Example: For a 70 kg adult, the top of the Table 1 dextrose range (8 g/kg/day) needs about 2800 mL a day; the Table 2 maximum infusion rate of 1.25 mL/kg/hour allows about 2100 mL a day (6 g/kg/day). The same text is in 2 labels from 2 labelers in the DailyMed release of 29 October 2026.
en.impact: Potential effect on a prescribing decision: low; careful reading of the whole label usually resolves it. Arxo does not say which instruction is correct and gives no dose.
